record.question: The Hooke’s joint consists of -
record.explanation: A Hooke universal joint consists of two forks (one on each shaft) joined through a central cross with four trunnions. The number of forks is two, not the number of trunnions. Reference: https://cdlsiet.ac.in/wp-content/uploads/2022/03/kom-Manuals.pdf. Original printed source and ordered choices independently reviewed. Verified worked solution, unofficial; no matching examiner key is asserted.
